config.text: Food Base LA
﻿Welcome to Food Base LA!

Food Base LA is a public-facing data portal designed to help monitor and understand food access, food security, and the "last mile" of the food system in Los Angeles County. It was co-developed by scientists, local government, and community partners, with funding from the U.S. National Science Foundation (Grant 2125616).

Los Angeles County Office of Food Systems


The Office of Food Systems is a public-private partnership, dedicated to cultivating a fair, resilient, and healthy food system for all LA County residents. They function as an innovation hub, collaborating with a diverse network of stakeholders to address food system challenges across LA County.

Link: https://lacountyfoodsystems.org/

Los Angeles Food Policy Council: The State of Good Food in Los Angeles


"The State of Good Food in Los Angeles: A Decade in Review" is a comprehensive resource for evaluating progress and challenges across the regional food system, with over 250 indicators from 10 Southern California counties.

Link to 2025 Report: https://www.goodfoodla.org/stateofgoodfoodreport

Los Angeles Regional Food Bank: Food Pantry Locator


Enter your address to find your local food pantry.

Link: https://www.lafoodbank.org/find-food/pantry-locator/

Food Assistance Programs & Food Resources


Information about various food assistance programs and resources that are available in Los Angeles County, such as CalFresh, after school meal programs, and Meals On Wheels.

Link: http://www.lapublichealth.org/nut/food_assistance_programs.htm

USC Food Systems Institute


The Food Systems Institute generates actionable scientific insights to help to build food systems that support human health, planetary health, and fairness.

Link: https://dornsife.usc.edu/cesr/fsi/

Los Angeles County Food Equity Roundtable Action Plan


This 10-year strategic action plan was published in 2022 by the LA County Food Equity Roundtable, a coalition of leading cross-sector organizations co-led by LA County and LA-area philanthropic partners.

Link: https://lacountyfoodequityroundtable.org/

USC Food and Nutrition Insecurity Research Team


Current 2025 reports and data on food and nutrition insecurity in LA County.

Link: https://public-exchange.org/usc/project/feeding-la/partnership/
